definition: נֹקֵד noun masculine sheep-raiser, -dealer, or -tender ( Lag NB108 ); — absolute ׳ נ only 2Kgs 3:4 (of Mesha, king of Moab); plural אֲשֶׁר בַּנֹּקְדִים מִתְּקוֺע Amos 1:1 (of Amos, see Dr ; compare Amos 7:14 , where read נוקד for בוקר according to We Now Dr , not GASm , see Bu below); perhaps gloss, compare Bu Kohut Memorial.106 f. Now on the passage
